cues.name: Identifying fragment about a third party
cues.definition: The detail that pinpoints another person: a name, workplace, school, precise location. Never the relational content itself — that is KEEP-REL; hybrids stack KEEP-REL over the sentence with NAR-THIRD on the fragment. Treatment ranges by the fragment's meaning: nuance 3 function-preserving blur, nuance 2 swap, nuance 0-1 replace with a smoothing bridge. Deleting details never deletes the person — coreference keeps every character in the story. These people did not consent to anything.
